reconciliation_status.description: Overall reconciliation result. 'Failed' if any domain mismatch exists. 'Warning' if no mismatches but confidential sellers found. 'Passed' if fully clean.

domain_mismatches.description: Entries where the sellers.json domain does not match the publisher_domain, or where no sellers.json record was found.

ssp.description: SSP name from the ads.txt entry.

pub_id.description: Publisher ID from the ads.txt entry.

expected_domain.description: The publisher_domain value that was expected.

found_domain.description: The domain found in sellers.json. Null if no matching record was found.

confidential_warnings.description: Entries where is_confidential=1 in sellers.json — always flagged regardless of domain match.

ssp.description: SSP name from the ads.txt entry.

pub_id.description: Publisher ID from the ads.txt entry.
